changes.description: Only what you changed: each an exact span of the current English and its replacement

paragraph.description: Paragraph ID as given, e.g. p12, or p21–p23 for a group

find.description: The exact text to replace, copied from the paragraph's English as given

answers.description: Note numbers this change answers (F1, R2); empty if no note asked for it

disagreements.description: Where the readers pulled opposite ways, or a note you couldn't settle

send_up.description: True only where the reading doesn't settle it and being wrong would matter

beyond_this_chapter.description: What you learned in this chapter that changes how an earlier chapter should read (a person, a word, what a scene means), for the house to take back to it. When nothing does, the list is empty

finding.description: What should change, in a sentence

why.description: What in this chapter shows it
